title: SpacEVM
tagline: An NFT marketplace for onchain space atmospheric data, to counter the bad role of agriculture in water usage on our planet. Copernicus data will be reliable, free for the next 40 years, and covers the whole world.
description:
Taking the concept of NFT utility and digital data ownership VS real utility, we aim to use Satellite data for atmospheric state by copernicus to bring even more accurate projection to smart agricolture businesses.
The mos water is wasted in agricolture, and with the right projection we can forelook the amount of water we need for our specific crop, using the available copernicus data and enhancing it with the sensors we provide, unlocked by our NFT ownership.
how_its_made:
Built with a standard NFT marketplace solidity contract deployed on FVM, unlockable content will be hosted on Filecoin along with the data from the sensors on fields, collected to enhance the dashboard already in place thanks to copernicus atmopheric data.
The Contract stores all NFT data onchain (SVG image)
